Before promising an enterprise deployment date, sales should use the following checklist:

- Use the official Enterprise implementation target of **8–10 weeks** (actual median: 8.7 weeks); do not promise the 4–6 week rollout that has caused customer friction [NL-031-S02][NL-015-S04].
- Run a **mandatory pre-onboarding format audit** during discovery: require a sample of ~20 core documents for format analysis, flag scanned PDFs/OCR requirements early, and adjust the timeline accordingly [NL-031-S06][NL-015-S04][NL-023-S07].
- Confirm **security review and SSO are pre-cleared**, permission mapping (AD/Entra ID) is scoped, and use approved AD/Entra ID templates where applicable [NL-031-S02][NL-031-S06].
- Verify **executive alignment and customer resource availability**, as these are the main drivers of enterprise implementation success [NL-031-S02].
- Ensure any **custom data-deletion commitments** go through legal/security review and align with the official 90-day standard deletion policy [NL-009-S08][NL-023-S07].
- Do **not guarantee roadmap or integration dates** (e.g., Microsoft Teams, WorkflowCoach); consult Product/Roadmap and present dates only as targets [NL-009-S08][NL-016-S05].
- Confirm the corpus can meet **go-live quality gates** (citation correctness and zero critical permission failures) and that formal go-live approval from sponsors/compliance can be obtained [NL-015-S04][NL-005-S08][NL-031-S02].
